report_metadata.title: Final Satlas-SR Research Report Consolidation
report_metadata.gpu_hardware: NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada Generation (16 GB VRAM)

verified_dataset_provenance.pairing_correspondence: 256 / 256 exact matching tile IDs (100% paired, zero missing)

cpsnr_crop4_db.protocol: PROBA-V stride-2 spatial offset search [-8, +8] with closed-form brightness bias compensation, crop border 4
cpsnr_crop4_db.paper_comparison_notes: Paper Table 2 evaluated Medium ESRGAN (~87M) across 8,192 multi-biome tiles, not Small ESRGAN (16.71M) on 256 urban tiles.

psnr_raw_fullframe_db.protocol: Standard unaligned full-frame MSE-based PSNR (no offset or brightness compensation)

psnr_crop4_db.protocol: Standard unaligned PSNR with 4-pixel border exclusion

ssim_raw_fullframe.protocol: Structural Similarity Index evaluated across full uncropped frame

ssim_crop4.protocol: Structural Similarity Index with 4-pixel border exclusion

lpips_vgg_distance.protocol: Raw $L_2$ perceptual feature distance in VGG network embedding space
lpips_vgg_distance.paper_comparison_notes: Paper Table 2 reports 63.8% representing 2AFC human-preference agreement accuracy from 11,524 AMT trials, not raw LPIPS distance.

clipscore_cosine_similarity.protocol: Normalized cosine similarity between deep image feature embeddings in [-1, 1]
clipscore_cosine_similarity.paper_comparison_notes: Continuous cosine similarity metric, not accuracy or percentage.

exp001_dense_cpsnr_sensitivity.interpretation: Mathematical sensitivity diagnostic: stride-1 search space is a strict superset of stride-2 search space, guaranteeing monotonic non-negative gain. It does not reflect a change in model synthesis quality.

spatial_registration_diagnostic.interpretation: Raster cross-correlation diagnostic evaluating relative high-frequency spatial alignment. Does not prove physical coordinate registration or absence of geometric hallucination.

level_1_completed_local_baseline.reproducibility: 100% deterministic, cryptographic hashes verified, all per-tile records consistent

level_2_evaluation_pipeline_reproduction.scope: Corrected PSNR (stride-2), raw PSNR/SSIM, VGG LPIPS distance, and CLIPScore cosine similarity algorithms validated

blockers: Medium ESRGAN (~87M parameters) checkpoint unreleased by authors
Full 8,192-tile nationwide multi-biome benchmark unavailable locally
Amazon Mechanical Turk 11,524 human comparison records unavailable locally
